name: G protein subunit alpha 13

function.text: GNA13 encodes guanine nucleotide-binding protein subunit alpha-13. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in signal transduction and Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma; Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Malignant Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
